people.name: Ahaz
people.line: King of Judah, son of Jotham

translations.web: In the time of his distress, he trespassed yet more against Yahweh, this same king Ahaz.
translations.bsb: In the time of his distress, King Ahaz became even more unfaithful to the LORD.
translations.kjv: And in the time of his distress did he trespass yet more against the LORD: this is that king Ahaz.
translations.asv: And in the time of his distress did he trespass yet more against Jehovah, this same king Ahaz.
